name: demand_batch_size
label_en: creatives in a full ad group (one batch from the maker)
label_zh: 一个完整广告组的素材数
explain: a batch is a control or first arm and its variants
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: demand_min_batch
label_en: fewest creatives worth an ad group of their own
label_zh: 一个广告组至少要有几条素材
explain: a smaller remainder waits for the next request
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: demand_min_verdicts
label_en: verdicts needed before more than one batch is asked for
label_zh: 要有多少个结论才一次要超过一批
explain: until then the first batch is the experiment that measures the cost
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: demand_max_batches
explain: a ceiling so a huge exploration wallet cannot ask for everything at once
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: demand_lead_days
label_en: days from asking to the first spend, until a request has been seen to reach one
label_zh: 从请求到第一笔花费的天数(观测到之前的暂定值)
explain: no end-to-end figure exists yet: this is a draft
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: demand_weeks
label_en: weeks of history the cost per verdict is read from
label_zh: 算每个结论成本时回看几周
explain: a flow over recent weeks, so a change in how creatives are made shows
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: demand_prior_verdicts
label_en: how many verdicts the lifecycle's doubt line counts for when the cost per verdict is shrunk toward it
label_zh: 把成本向存疑线收缩时,存疑线等于几个结论
explain: with few verdicts the cost leans on the doubt line, with many on the measured flow
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: demand_lost_factor
label_en: a request with no first spend after this many lead times is taken as lost and asked again
label_zh: 请求超过几倍的交付时间仍没花费就当作遗失
explain: a request that never reached a spend would otherwise block the next one
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
